when: apt-get install nodejs (NodeSource 20.x) fails with "trying to overwrite '/usr/include/node/common.gypi', which is also in package libnode-dev" or "Sub-process /usr/bin/dpkg returned an error code"
action: Ubuntu's stock libnode-dev (v12) conflicts with NodeSource's nodejs. Run `apt-get remove -y libnode-dev nodejs npm`, then `apt-get install -y nodejs`, then confirm with `node -v` (should be v20.x) and `npm -v` before running yarn/npm commands. Do not retry the same install command.

when: `which node npm` finds nothing (or `cat package.json` fails) on a JavaScript repo setup task
action: Install Node and npm with `apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq nodejs npm`. Then wait for any background apt-get to exit before using node, for example `until which npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pgrep -x apt-get >/dev/null; do sleep 3; done`, and confirm with `node -v; npm -v`. Only then run `npm install`.
